advancement.createsprings.pse_dash.desc:
use steam dash while using steam dash
§7(Hidden Advancement)
advancement.createsprings.spring_age.des: Use Spring Alloy to create a casing for 1 recipe and decoration
create.spring.stopped: it looks like the spring can't move further because of non breakable blocks
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_1: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Spring Catapult to select its target location
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_2: The placed Catapult will now launch objects to the marked location
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_3: A valid target can be anywhere with in range of 150 blocks
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_4: If no Target was selected, it will do nothing
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_5: Items placed in the catapult cause it to trigger
createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_6: Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it
createsprings.ponder.catapult_second_tar: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Spring Catapult to select its main target
Sneak and Right-Click Two times to select its second target
After receiving or shooting items catapult will switch targets
createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_1: When an explosion occurs near the spring, spring will receive some charge
createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_2: spring will receive charge even is explosion source is in water
createsprings.ponder.hardness.text_1: Input and output speed can be configured
createsprings.ponder.hardness.text_2: Using the value panel, you can select it
createsprings.ponder.hardness.text_3: the greater the spring hardness, the more su the spring consumes when charging and the more energy it produces when unchanging
createsprings.ponder.kinetic_interface.t: Moving springs can be tricky to access
This component can interact with springs without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of 1 block inbetween
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL springs and large springs on the contraption
if stationary interface is rotating, springs on contraption will charge
if stationary interface is powered it will generate energy using springs on the contraption
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_1: To construct large spring place a 3*3 square of Large Spring Coils
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_2: All placed coils should be directed in the same direction
createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_3: Add hollow rings of coils to make spring longer
When central block of first layer is powered large spring will start releasing stored energy
Spring speed depends on the signal strength
Large springs also support Splash mode
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_1: Springs is able to store rotational force
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_2: direction of rotation does not matter
createsprings.ponder.spring.text_3: when activated spring will release stored kinetic energy
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.header: Using rotational force stored in springs
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_1: Click the spring with tripwire hook to switch its mode
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_2: click with empty hand to switch its mode back
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_3: springs will instantly release stored energy when activated
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_6: some blocks needs more charge to break
createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_7: springs do not break kinetic mechanisms and pressure plates
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_1: Friction Welding is an another way to process blocks
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_2: The rotation of both welders must be the same, but opposite by direction
createsprings.ponder.welding.text_3: when there is some blocks between welders welding will be started
createsprings.pse.tooltip.5: increasing the speed of spring tools
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive: when _overdrive_ is turned on _PSE_ will work with maximum speed in any mode, but _pressure_ in engine will constantley _rise_, When _pressure_ hits _100_ engine _explodes_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive2: you will be able to do _steam dash_ when pressure is more than 70 to lower pressure but it is a _temporary measure_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.water: when there is _no water_ in the engine, _PSE_ will try find _water bucket_ in the _inventory_ if it finds _water bucket_ inner tank will be _restored_ and water bucket _wouldn't be spent_

item.createsprings.explosion_chamber.too: R-click with a _spring_ and _fuel_ in the chamber
item.createsprings.hat.tooltip.summary: A _hat_. can be _dyed_ or _placed_ on the ground and also can store _1 stack_ , if engineer _goggles_ are inside it will function as engineer _goggles_
item.createsprings.portative_steam_engin: Allows for a _Steam Dash_ when the _pressure_ level is above _70_, Also reduces the _pressure_
A small _Steam Engine_ capable of _charging_ tools, lighting the way, and also _warming_ and _accelerating_ players
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.beh: if punchcard is in a tool and it is _waiting for activation_, the next _instruction_ will be executed _instantly_
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.sum: Can _program_ some tools by executing _simple instructions_ in cycle, can hold a _small amount_ of commands
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.c: When a spring is _stacked_ on the tool
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.s: A Base for _spring-powered_ tools, can hold up to _2 springs_, to transform it into a spring tool place a _modifier_ inside
Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
A _spring-powered_ drill, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Mining _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.su: A _portable_ spring-powered _Fan_, Can hold up to _2 springs_, pushes entities _to_ or _from_ the player, direction changes when _Shift_ is pressed, Works on _elytra_
item.createsprings.spring_launcher.toolt: releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
fires a spring alloy block that _explodes_ on _landing_
R-click with springs in the launcher
R-click with a spring and a spring alloy block in the launcher
A _powerful_ weapon that can _fire springs_ or _spring alloy blocks_, scope can be added by _placing a spyglass_ inside
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.su: A _spring-powered_ saw, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
A _spring-powered_ shovel, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
item.createsprings.sus_package.tooltip.s: This package when _dropped_ from a height or _destroyed_, releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
tooltip.springstuf.createsprings:punchca: allows you to program spring tools
